5,347 likes, 126 comments - delhitravelblogger on September 14, 2026: "East Delhi mein ek lake hai jahan 90 species ke birds aate hain — aur zyada logon ko iske baare mein pata hi nahi 🦆🌿

Ye hai Sanjay Lake, Trilokpuri — DDA ne 1982 mein Yamuna aur Hindon river ke back-flow se banaya tha ye artificial lake. 42 acres ka lake, 170 acres ke green forest ke beech — Delhi ke sabse peaceful spots mein se ek.

Boating bhi try kar sakte ho, ya bas shaam ko yahan chill karne aa jao — no crowd, pure nature 🚣

📍 Trilokpuri, East Delhi (Mayur Vihar II ke paas)
🕙 6:00 AM – 8:00 PM, daily (no weekly off)
🎟️ Entry free | Boating ~₹130/person (20 min)

📱 Shot on iPhone 16 Pro".

450 likes, 16 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 28, 2026: "Delhi ke beech me ek aisi jagah chupi hai jo dikhti hai filmo jaisi, par hai 800 saal purani... 😱

Ye hai Agrasen Ki Baoli - Hailey Road, Connaught Place ke paas.

14th century ki ye baoli 108 seedhiyon wali hai, aur kehte hain yaha ka paani kabhi kala pad jata tha, log ise Delhi ki sabse haunted jagah bhi maante hain.

PK film se lekar Sultan tak, kitni filmo ki shooting yaha hui hai, aur shaam ko jab light jalti hai na, tab ye jagah sabse zyada khoobsurat lagti hai.

Entry bilkul free hai, timing subah 9 se shaam 5:30 tak, nearest metro Barakhamba Road.

Agar Delhi me ho aur yaha nahi aaye to kya hi aaye? Apne us dost ko tag karo jo darta hai yaha aane se 👻👇

agrasen ki baoli delhi | hailey road delhi | haunted place in delhi | delhi hidden gems | connaught place delhi

#agrasenkibaoli #haileyroad #haunteddelhi #delhihiddengems #delhitravelblogger".

posts.meta_description:
265 likes, 12 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 28, 2026: "Munnar Ki Sabse Thrilling Zipline Kar Li Maine! 😱🔥

Munnar me maine try ki dukki devi kulam ki famous zipline, aur sach me dil ek second ke liye ruk gaya tha. 

Upar se neeche tak sirf green tea gardens, hawa aur full adventure. Agar tumhe bhi Kerala me kuch alag karna hai toh ye wali zipline miss mat karna.

Location: dukki devi kulam, munnar, kerala
Best time: subah 9 se 11 baje, bheed kam hoti hai
Price: approx 800 se start hai

Agar tum bhi Munnar jaane wale ho toh is post ko save kar lo aur apne us dost ko tag karo jo aise adventure se darta hai.

Follow karo @delhitravelblogger ko aise hi hidden gems ke liye, kyunki Delhi se Kerala tak sabse engaging aur unique content yahi milta hai.

munnar zipline, dukki devi kulam, munnar adventure, kerala travel, munnar tourist places

#munnarzipline #dukkiadevikulam #keralatravel #munnaradventure #delhitravelblogger".

347 likes, 21 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 28, 2026: "Comment SHOES aur main DM mein Tank Road ki sabse sasti dukaan bhej dunga 👟

Ye hai Tank Road, Karol Bagh ka wholesale shoes market. Yahan chappal ₹10 se aur shoes ₹150–200 se start hote hain.

Jajoria Shoes aur Garg Footwear yahan ki sabse famous dukaanein hain. Zyadatar maal export surplus wala hai.

Market Monday ko band rehti hai, toh weekend ya weekday plan karo.

Delhi mein sasta joota ya shoes wholesale market dhoondh rahe ho toh Tank Road se sasta kam hi milega.

#tankroad #karolbagh #shoesmarket #wholesalemarket #delhitravelblogger".

429 likes, 19 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 27, 2026: "Comment COVER aur main DM mein Gaffar Market ki 3 sabse sasti dukaanon ki list bhej dunga 📱

Ye hai Karol Bagh ka Gaffar Market, Delhi ka sabse bada mobile cover wholesale market. Yahan phone cover sirf ₹5–7 se start hote hain.

Neeraj bhai ki shop pe maine khud iPhone ka cover ₹16 mein dekha. Wholesale mein minimum order ₹5,000 ka hai.

Location: Hongkong Plaza, Karol Bagh Metro ke paas.

Agar sasta mobile cover market ya mobile accessories wholesale market Delhi mein dhoondh rahe ho, toh yahin aana.

#gaffarmarket #karolbagh #mobilecover #wholesalemarket #delhitravelblogger".

296 likes, 49 comments - delhitravelblogger on October 23, 2026: "Comment LIGHT aur main DM mein 3 sabse sasti trusted dukaanon ki location aur shop numbers bhej dunga 🪔

Ye hai Bhagirath Palace, Chandni Chowk, Lajpat Rai Market ke bilkul saath. Asia ki sabse badi electrical market, 1000 se zyada dukaanein.

Diwali lights aur jhalar yahan ₹15 se shuru hoti hai, aur jo jhoomar bahar ₹10,000 ka milta hai wo yahan ₹2,000 mein mil jaata hai. LED lights, wires, switches, Havells, Anchor, Polycab, sab wholesale rate pe.

Delhi mein sasta jhoomar market ya Diwali decoration ka wholesale market dhoondh rahe ho toh yahi jagah hai.

Timing: 11:30 AM se 6:30 PM. Sunday band rehta hai.

Ek hi cheez ke 10 alag rate milenge, toh bina bargain kiye kuch mat lena.

#bhagirathpalace #chandnichowk #diwalilights #wholesalemarket #delhitravelblogger".
